dossier.summary: Halyard Freightworks is a truckload and intermodal carrier serving manufacturers in the Midwest. Its sales team sells dedicated fleet contracts. The site lists 14 regional sales offices.
dossier.why_now: Opened a cross-dock in Columbus and posted six openings for regional sales managers.
